# intervalpsych

The **intervalpsych** package provides a toolbox for the analysis of
interval responses in psychometrics and similar disciplines. Interval
responses can be used to represent uncertainty or variability in
responses to survey items, for example. Besides transformation and
plotting function, the package also contains a wrapper to estimate the
Interval Consensus Model (ICM; [Kloft, Siepe & Heck,
2024](https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/dzvw2)) in the probabilistic
programming language [**Stan**](https://mc-stan.org/). Results of the
model can be visualized and summarized using the functions provided in
the package.

## Installation

You can install the released version of **intervalpsych** from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r
install.packages("intervalpsych")
```

You can install the latest development version of **intervalpsych** from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("matthiaskloft/intervalpsych")
```

# Package index

## Transformation functions

Transformation functions for interval data.

- [`ilr()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/log_ratio_transformations.md)
  [`slr()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/log_ratio_transformations.md)
  : Log-Ratio transformations for interval responses
- [`inv_ilr()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/inv_log_ratio_transformations.md)
  [`inv_slr()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/inv_log_ratio_transformations.md)
  : Inverse Log-Ratio transformations for interval responses
- [`itvl_to_splx()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/itvl_to_splx.md)
  : Convert from interval bounds to simplex
- [`splx_to_itvl()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/splx_to_itvl.md)
  : Convert from simplex to interval bounds
- [`remove_zeros()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/remove_zeros.md)
  : Remove Zeros from Simplex

## Plotting functions

Plotting functions for interval data.

- [`plot_intervals()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/plot_intervals.md)
  : Plot Intervals

- [`plot_intervals_cumulative()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/plot_intervals_cumulative.md)
  : Plot Cumulative Intervals

- [`theme_icm()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/theme_icm.md)
  :

  Custom ggplot2 Theme for `intervalpsych`

## Model fitting

Fit models to interval responses.

- [`fit_icm()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/fit_icm.md)
  : Fit the Interval Consensus Model
- [`extract_consensus()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/extract_consensus.md)
  : Extract consensus intervals from ICM Stan Fit Object
- [`plot_consensus()`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/plot_consensus.md)
  : Plot ICM Consensus Intervals
- [`plot(`*`<icm_stanfit>`*`)`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/plot.icm_stanfit.md)
  : Plot Method for icm_stanfit Objects
- [`summary(`*`<icm_stanfit>`*`)`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/summary.icm_stanfit.md)
  : Summarize ICM Stanfit Object

## Example data

Example data sets for interval data.

- [`quantifiers`](https://matthiaskloft.github.io/intervalpsych/reference/quantifiers.md)
  : Verbal Quantifier Data
